about: Canon geography for Aleria, used by the map generator. Every entry has a status: confirmed (stated in the author's lore notes), inferred (a reasonable reading of the lore, not stated outright) or placeholder (invented for the map; replace or confirm). Numeric layout hints are always inferred: the lore gives compass directions, not coordinates.

sources.note: 'Lore tab' means the author's worldbuilding tab of the Main doc, titled 'A (Real) Guide for Heroes'. The doc has no tab literally named 'Lore'.

world.name: Aleria
world.notes: Five named continents, separated by seas. A surface world above the Underworld, where mana pools because it sinks.

continents.name: Kremantin
continents.notes: The central continent. A melting pot of races, home to the Kingdom of Elysandria and other human-dominated nations, seat of the Church of Ucliat, and the main site of Hero summonings.

continents.name: Menfor
continents.notes: A separate continent, not a region of Kremantin. Vast, harsh and sparsely populated. Origin and main homeland of the Tenebrim. The Grand Monarch came from here and invaded across the seas.

continents.name: Lintur
continents.notes: Wild frontier with megafauna, rare creatures and plants, and isolated civilizations. Rumoured ruins from before the Lost Age.

continents.name: Tantser
continents.notes: Largely unexplored and the subject of myths; few who sail there return. Maps show it as fragmented and veiled in storms, so it should render as fogged, storm-covered islands.

continents.name: The Northern Expanse
continents.climate: eternal winter (a permanent result of a past Doomsday)
continents.notes: The elven continent, ancestral home of the Elves and the Gorthon Federation. Buried Ancient complexes lie under the frost; elven cities run on geothermal and steam infrastructure. It is far from Kremantin and does not rely on Heroes.

nations.name: Kingdom of Elysandria
nations.ruler: Queen Elisabeth Bernt Ravenshield III ("the Iron Queen")
nations.notes: The central human nation and primary seat of the Church of Ucliat. Its lands mix plains, ancient forests and mountains, with trade routes, farmland, fortified borders against monster incursions, and scattered remnants of an older era. Its very high mana quality is why summonings happen here.

nations.name: Gorthon Federation
nations.government: federation of self-governing elven states under an elven council
nations.notes: Technologically ahead of the human nations (magi-tech).

nations.name: Other human-dominated nations of Kremantin
nations.notes: Their existence is confirmed; their names, number and positions are unknown. The generator should treat them as placeholders.

places.name: Capital of Elysandria
places.notes: A palace complex intertwined with religious buildings, including the summoning chamber that holds the Core Seal. Home of the Crimson Sun Order's JOAT sub-branch. The city's proper name is not given.

places.name: Rikardia
places.position: in the north (of the Northern Expanse)
places.notes: An elven city and Federation state. It worships a Goddess of Frost, not Ucliat.

places.name: Sealed siphoning facility
places.position: deepest point of the Underworld (no surface location given)
places.notes: The single place where Doomsdays originate. It belongs on an Underworld layer, not on the surface map.

underworld.notes: A second realm under the surface, lit by crystals and home to Devil civilization. It is split into four regions, each ruled by a Fuhmar, with Constaelous managing sectors beneath them. Not drawn yet; it could become an optional layer or a separate map.

organizations.name: Church of Ucliat
organizations.notes: The dominant religion across most human nations. Churches around the world hold appraisal devices.

organizations.name: Church Knights
organizations.notes: The Church's militia, guarding churches worldwide. Insignia: silver chains, sword-crossed sun medallions and a halo-like headpiece.

organizations.name: Crimson Sun Order
organizations.notes: A Mellet-dominated branch of the Church. Its sanctums are usually underground or in mountains; the JOAT sub-branch is in the capital of Elysandria. A few sanctums use unethical methods.
organizations.placementRule: sanctums underground or in mountains; one in the capital

races.name: Humans
races.notes: The dominant race of Kremantin's nations.

races.name: Tenebrim
races.notes: Very uncommon on Kremantin. Clan-based, with little coin trade.

races.name: Devils
races.source: Main doc, Lore tab; Races tab
races.notes: Come from very hot regions; also present on Kremantin.

races.name: Mellets
races.notes: Clustered inside the Church and the Crimson Sun Order.

races.name: Beastkin
races.placementRule: small secluded tribal communities in forests and remote valleys

races.name: Demi-humans
races.notes: Present in Elysandrian society and its army.

races.name: Equars
races.notes: Short folk with no nations; they live as family units.

races.name: Narelith
races.placementRule: rare; appear where mana is abundant

races.name: Lumenari
races.notes: Appear once every few centuries; no fixed sites.

seas.notes: Seas separate the continents (the Grand Monarch crossed them from Menfor). No sea or ocean names are given, so all generated sea names are placeholders.

rules.rule: Villages exist only where local Hunters or Adventurers can manage monsters. High Star-rank beast territories are forbidden zones that shape travel and trade routes.
Dungeons form where mana gathers: underground near crystals, old battlefields and mass graves. Kingdoms keep them as economic resources.
Crystals are common in mountains, dungeons and other mana-rich places. Low-mana wastelands and depleted regions also exist.
Wealth concentrates in political and religious capitals and major guild cities.

scale.notes: No distances are given. The scale bar's 'leagues' is a placeholder.

v1Placeholders.name: Menfor as a northern region of Kremantin
v1Placeholders.notes: Contradicted by canon: Menfor is its own continent to the north.

v1Placeholders.name: Frozen Lands / Frozen Holds (NE Kremantin)
v1Placeholders.notes: Contradicted by canon: the frozen land is the Northern Expanse, a separate continent.

v1Placeholders.name: Southern Jungles (S Kremantin)
v1Placeholders.notes: Contradicted by canon: the jungle continent is Lintur, to the southwest. Kremantin is temperate to subtropical.

v1Placeholders.name: Storm-Shrouded Reach (SE Kremantin)
v1Placeholders.notes: Contradicted by canon: the storm-veiled land is Tantser, a separate continent to the southeast.

v1Placeholders.name: Beastfolk Prides, Rih-Fugh Enclaves, Tenebrim Reaches (states)
v1Placeholders.notes: No such states exist in the lore. Beastkin live in small tribes, Tenebrim come from Menfor, and 'Rih-Fugh' does not appear (the horned, third-eyed people match the Veyrith Devil subtype).
